label: prf:quantum-universe-exists
title: Proof of existence of quantum universes
html: Witness: \mathbf{C} = R\text{-}\mathrm{Mod} (finite-dimensional R-modules) with A = R as the trivial Frobenius--Hopf algebra, \tau = \mathrm{id}, and \Omega^1(R) = 0. Since \Omega^1(R) = 0 the differential-calculus axiom holds vacuously, and A = R carries the ground-ring Frobenius--Hopf structure, so each remaining axiom is satisfied trivially. A richer witness is \mathbf{C} = \mathbf{Rep}(\mathrm{SU}(2)) (Example) with A the regular representation. Both establish existence.
